subject: Re: Redwood discovery — next steps & pricing
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>
To: Jamie Park <jamie.park@acme.com>
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.inference
Date: Wed, 01 Jul 2026 16:10:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood discovery — notes & recommended next steps

Hi Jamie —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery call so we have the same page: 

- Primary use case: customer-facing chat and summarization across support tickets (avg. seq length ~ 512 tokens).
- Key constraints: < 100ms tail latency target for live chat, SOC 2 compliance, VPC option for PHIish data.
- Current volume: ~500K tokens/month, expected to 2–3M in 6 months with seasonal peaks.

Recommended next steps we discussed: 
1) I’ll share a short proposed mutual action plan and a hosted vs dedicated cost estimate (see attached pricing).
2) We can run a 1-week pilot on Dedicated capacity with a small reserved pool for realistic throughput testing.
3) If procurement needs an initial security checklist, I can loop in our security lead and provide SOC 2 artifacts.

Attachments: redwood-pricing-v2.pdf (application/pdf) — quick hosted vs dedicated cost models and pilot scoping.

Would you be able to confirm which of these next steps you prefer this week? If helpful, I can schedule a follow-up to walk the team through the pricing and pilot metrics.

Thanks,
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.inference | (555) 555-0112

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>

Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.inference
Date: Tue, 07 Jul 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Checking in — pilot vs pricing for Acme

Hi Jamie —

Bumping this in case it got buried. Did you have any initial reactions to the pricing attachment I shared last week? Two quick options to move forward:

A) Schedule a 30-min pricing walk-through with me + Aditya (our solutions lead) to align on pilot sizing.
B) If you’re not ready, tell me the right timeline and I’ll follow up at that cadence.

Either way I want to make sure we don’t schedule the pilot until we’ve aligned on the expected traffic profile.

Best,
Marissa

Hi Jamie —

Hope you’re doing well. Just wanted to check whether this is still a priority for Acme right now. A few quick signals that would help me:

- Are you aiming to start a pilot in the next 30–60 days?
- Do you need security artifacts before moving to procurement?
- Is there someone on your side I should bring in to speed approvals (e.g., cloud infra or procurement contact)?

If timing has shifted, totally understand — just trying to keep our resources aligned. If I don’t hear back in a week I’ll send one final email to close the loop.

Thanks,
Marissa
